entities.name: Elemental
entities.description: Sentient beings composed of elemental energy, found on many planes in all five colors.

entities.name: Maro-Sorcerer
entities.description: A manifestation of the land itself, most of which dwelt on Dominaria.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event after which Alaran elementals began appearing beyond Jund.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon whose corruption of Amonkhet produced wild elementals.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: The event during which elementals rose to turn on Naktamun and reduce it to rubble.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: A city of Amonkhet destroyed by elementals during the Hour of Devastation.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Huge, earth-shaking elemental predators of Bloomburrow that bring climate change and disaster, led by Maha.

entities.name: Maha, the Night Owl
entities.description: The leader of the Calamity Beasts of Bloomburrow.

entities.name: Aboroth
entities.description: Gigantic fungal elementals that arise near Llanowar villages and rampage until they wither away.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship whose crew fought two Aboroths in Llanowar while recruiting Mirri.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A character the Weatherlight crew went to Llanowar to recruit.

entities.name: Niroso
entities.description: Stone elementals created during the Brothers' War, lured by the sorceress Sacumon to start a war and creators of the coal golems.

entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: A sorceress who lured the Niroso to instigate a war between minotaurs and elves.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war during which the Niroso were created.

entities.name: Flamekin
entities.description: Passionate human-sized fire elementals of Lorwyn, warriors and shamans who are sworn enemies of the elves.

entities.name: Cinders
entities.description: Flamekin who lost their flames, said to have been taken by the Extinguisher, and who follow the Path of Sorrow.

entities.name: Extinguisher
entities.description: A traitor said to have taken the cinders' flames in the Extinguishing.

entities.name: Extinguishing
entities.description: The legendary event in which the cinders' flames were taken.

entities.name: Rimekin
entities.description: Cold-logic elementals born from flamekin whose emotions grew too hot during the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that reduced the numbers of cinders and gave rise to rimekin.

entities.name: Brighthearth
entities.description: A group of flamekin who act as emissaries of goodwill to other races.

entities.name: Greater Elementals
entities.description: Living embodiments of the abstract ideas and dreams of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor's people.

entities.name: Flame-kin
entities.description: Magically created fire elemental soldiers of the Boros Legion, blessed by Angels.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that creates flame-kin soldiers.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A Ravnican guild known for its nature elementals.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that created the cytospawn elementals.

entities.name: Weirds
entities.description: Paradoxical creatures combining opposing elements, created by Niv-Mizzet and used as lab assistants by the Izzet League.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon who created the weirds during the Katazar-Razblat Elemental Symposium.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that uses weirds as lab assistants and machinery.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that uses woodwraiths.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: A Ravnican guild associated with wood-kin.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: A Tarkir clan whose shamans were best versed in the plane's elementals.

entities.name: Scaldkin
entities.description: Elementals of heat and boiling water born in the Qal Sisma Mountains.

entities.name: Windfolk
entities.description: Elemental beings of snow and air who only Temur shamans can communicate with.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The god of the sea whose will Theran elementals extend.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: The activity on Zendikar through which its elementals awaken.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The invaders of Zendikar that the plane's elementals rose against as antibodies.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose arrival on Innistrad made the elementals more aggressive.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: An Ixalan people who construct jade totems to hold elementals in stasis.

entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: The Strixhaven college whose mages sculpt shells for living elemental art.

entities.name: Maro
entities.description: A nature elemental whose creature type was changed to Elemental.

entities.name: Silvos
entities.description: An elemental born from the Mirari on Dominaria.

entities.name: Cytospawn
entities.description: Huge humanoid elementals of living cytoplast created by the Simic Combine.

events.summary: During the Hour of Devastation elementals rise from burning rock, the Luxa River and the desert to turn on Naktamun and reduce it to rubble.
events.quote: elementals arose from burning rock, the blood-tainted waters of the Luxa River, and the sands of the desert itself to turn on Naktamun and reduce it to rubble

events.summary: The Weatherlight crew defeats the first Aboroth in Llanowar by traditional means.
events.quote: The first one was defeated traditionally

events.summary: The sorceress Sacumon lures the Niroso to start a war between the minotaurs of Urhaalan Valley and the elves of Eln Forest.
events.quote: They were lured by the sorceress Sacumon to instigate a war between the minotaurs of Urhaalan Valley and elves of Eln Forest during the Dark Age .

events.summary: The Niroso build the coal golems from coal deposits as shock troops.
events.quote: They were also the creators of the coal golems, which they built from coal deposits in the earth using magic.

events.summary: The Extinguisher takes the cinders' flames in the Extinguishing, sending them down the Path of Sorrow.
events.quote: the cinders' flames were taken long ago by a traitor known as the Extinguisher in an event known as the Extinguishing.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion many cinders question their nihilism; some become rimekin and others regain a warmer flame on Lorwyn.
events.quote: Some cinders became rimekin, content with the new flame that the change brought them.

events.summary: Rimekin emerge from flamekin whose emotions grew too hot during the Phyrexian invasion.
events.quote: born from flamekin whose emotions had grown too hot

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet, bored with the squabbling elementalists, combines opposing elements to create the first weirds.
events.quote: The dragon , bored with the squabbling of the various elementalists , combined opposing elements to create the paradoxical creatures.

events.summary: Emrakul's arrival makes Innistrad's elementals more aggressive.
events.quote: In the wake of Emrakul 's arrival, the elementals, like the Gnarlwood Dryad , became more aggressive.

events.summary: Zendikari elementals rise as pieces of the plane acting as antibodies against the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Several elementals rose as pieces of the plane itself, acting as antibodies to the Eldrazi .

events.summary: The Weatherlight crew defeats a second Aboroth by immobilizing it with the Thran Forge and the Touchstone until it shrinks to nothing.
events.quote: the second one was defeated by immobilizing it with the Thran Forge

relations.note: He created the weirds at the Katazar-Razblat Elemental Symposium.
relations.quote: Weirds were created by Niv-Mizzet during the Katazar-Razblat Elemental Symposium.

relations.note: They are created to serve as soldiers in the Boros Legion.
relations.quote: made to wear armor and serve as soldiers in the Boros Legion

relations.note: They are ubiquitous lab assistants to the Izzet League.
relations.quote: ubiquitous lab assistants to the Izzet League

relations.note: Cytospawn are created by the Simic Combine.
relations.quote: are huge humanoid elementals created by the Simic Combine
